summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 news release and a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report disclosing that, following completion of its previously announced voluntary delisting from the TSX Venture Exchange on September 2, 2026, it re-engaged IR Agency LLC for investor relations and marketing services on substantially the same terms disclosed in its May 19, 2026 and August 28, 2026 releases. The filing also reiterates ongoing Nasdaq listing-standard compliance risk. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The delisting itself is the special-situation event, already announced and now consummated; the IR engagement is ancillary. What to watch: continued Nasdaq compliance and any subsequent financing or listing-transfer moves.
